## Checklist

### General

- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) guide.
- [ ] My code follows the code style guidelines of this project.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code.
- [ ] I have commented my code where necessary, particularly in hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] My changes do not introduce any new warnings or errors.

### Notebooks

- [ ] The notebook runs from top to bottom without errors (Kernel > Restart & Run All).
- [ ] Cell outputs have been cleared before committing (unless outputs are essential).
- [ ] The notebook begins with a title, objective, and description in a markdown cell.
- [ ] All visualizations have axis labels, titles, and are readable.

### New Projects

- [ ] The dataset is real-world and contains at least 5,000 rows.
- [ ] The dataset source URL and license are documented in the notebook.
- [ ] No large data files (over 10 MB) are committed to the repository.
- [ ] The project follows the required directory structure (`Day_XX_Topic_Name/`).
- [ ] A `README.md` is included in the project directory.
- [ ] Exploratory data analysis includes at least 3 visualizations.

### Dependencies

- [ ] Any new dependencies are added to `requirements.txt` with minimum version pins.
- [ ] No unnecessary dependencies have been introduced.

### Testing

- [ ] I have added or updated tests where applicable.
- [ ] All existing tests pass (`pytest`).
